question: Odacchi! I was surprised to see all those strange animals from the movie Strong World appearing one after another in the Elbaph Arc! I really like the idea of bringing them into the main story! Land
answer: That's right. A lot of the animals I designed for the movie appear in Elbaph. Well, it's a pain to think of something new... but, I originally created those animals with the theme of "what would happen if living things evolved in a world where strength is everything", so it was actually pretty easy... well, I thought that animals from a country of warriors would be the same, so I included them! It's not like it was too much of a pain to think of something else, okay!!
name: 420 Land
